name: Secret Home 3 -Kuroi Yukata Shiroi Hada-
original_name: Secret Home 3-クロイユカタシロイハダ-
source:
Secret Home 3 is a BL-style produced visual novel. R-18. 

It is a story of a young boy who is taken in by a strange home and have various things happen to him. This time features yukata clothing. 

Includes 60 pieces of CG and 21 insert illustrations including content cuts and backgrounds.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077426.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《秘密之家3》是一部男性恋爱题材的视觉小说，面向18岁及以上玩家。

故事讲述了一位被奇怪的家庭收留的少年，以及发生在他身上的种种事情。这次还会出现浴衣服装。

包含60张CG和21幅插图，其中包括内容插画及背景。

（摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077426.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
